purpose: Guard Phase 0.0 output-mode resolution: output: arg > active plan_output: config > md default; unknown values fall through with a note; commented config lines are never matched; pipeline runs force md; conventional-commit prefixes are not consumed as flag tokens.
non_purpose: Not testing plan content quality — only which format the plan lands in and how the flag tokens are parsed.

variance_protocol.pass_threshold: 2/2 runs resolve the same, expected format

grading_pipeline.stage_1: Programmatic: file extension of the written plan in .ai/plans/ (.md vs .html), plus presence/absence of the ignored-value note where specified.
grading_pipeline.stage_2: None needed except eval 6, where an LLM grader confirms the feature description survived intact.

setup: Each eval states the required .compound-engineering/config.local.yaml content. Create/overwrite it in a scratch repo before the run; delete it after.

evals.name: commented-config-ignored
evals.prompt: /ce-plan Add retry with exponential backoff to the webhook dispatcher.
evals.expected_behavior: Plan written as .md (default). The commented line must not activate HTML mode.
evals.notes: The original defect class: the shipped config template documents the option as '# plan_output: html'; matching it as active silently forced HTML on every run. Run history (2026-07-26): 2/2 fresh runs wrote Markdown and ignored the commented config.

evals.name: arg-overrides-config
evals.prompt: /ce-plan output:md Add retry with exponential backoff to the webhook dispatcher.
evals.expected_behavior: Plan written as .md — CLI arg beats active config.
evals.notes: Run history (2026-07-26): 2/2 fresh runs wrote Markdown because output:md overrode active HTML config.

evals.name: active-config-html
evals.prompt: /ce-plan Add retry with exponential backoff to the webhook dispatcher.
evals.expected_behavior: Plan written as .html — active config applies when no arg is given.
evals.must_not: An .md plan (would mean config is never read).
evals.notes: Run history (2026-07-26): 2/2 fresh runs wrote HTML from the active config.

evals.name: unknown-value-fallthrough
evals.prompt: /ce-plan output:pdf Add retry with exponential backoff to the webhook dispatcher.
evals.expected_behavior: Plan written as .md, and a one-line note near the post-generation menu that the unknown 'pdf' value was ignored, naming the format actually used.
evals.must_not: Silent acceptance (no note), a hard error, or treating 'output:pdf' as part of the feature description.
evals.notes: Run history (2026-07-26): 2/2 fresh runs fell through to Markdown and named the ignored pdf value.

evals.name: pipeline-forces-md
evals.prompt: Invoke ce-plan as a sub-step from another skill (e.g., ce-brainstorm handoff dispatch), with HTML config active.
evals.expected_behavior: Plan written as .md — pipeline/sub-step invocations force md regardless of arg or config.
evals.must_not: An .html plan in a pipeline run.
evals.notes: Requires a pipeline-context harness; if impractical to stage, mark inconclusive rather than passing vacuously. Run history (2026-07-26): 2/2 staged parent ce-brainstorm handoffs forced Markdown despite active HTML config.

evals.name: commit-prefix-passthrough
evals.prompt: /ce-plan feat: add rate limiting to the public API
evals.expected_behavior: Plan written as .md; the description keeps 'feat: add rate limiting to the public API' intact — 'feat:' is not consumed as a flag token.
evals.must_not: A plan about 'add rate limiting' with the prefix stripped, or 'feat:' interpreted as an unknown output value.
evals.notes: Run history (2026-07-26): 2/2 fresh runs wrote Markdown and preserved the literal feat: prefix in the plan title.
